title: PhyGaP: Physically-Grounded Gaussians with Polarization Cues
novelty: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated great success in modeling reflective 3D ob- jects and their interaction with the environment via deferred rendering (DR).

title: PQDT: Pseudo-Query Dual Transformer for Robust Point Cloud Restoration
novelty: We propose a unified 3D restoration network that directly takes point clouds as input and adaptively reconstructs high-quality geometry under di- verse degradation scenarios.

title: Hg-I2P: Bridging Modalities for Generalizable Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration via Heterogeneous Graphs
novelty: A unified heterogeneous graph that simultaneously refines cross-modal features (HE-adapting) and prunes incorrect correspondences (HC-pruning), with multi-path edge mining that exploits both modalities' neighborhood structures to predict reliable cross-modal links.

title: InfiniDepth: Arbitrary-Resolution and Fine-Grained Depth Estimation with Neural Implicit Fields
novelty: Continuous neural implicit depth representation enabling arbitrary-resolution prediction with localized feature gathering for fine geometric detail recovery without training resolution constraints.

title: PDD: Manifold-Prior Diverse Distillation for Medical Anomaly Detection
novelty: pose PDD (Manifold-Prior Diverse Distillation), a novel

title: Repurposing 3D Generative Model for Autoregressive Layout Generation
novelty: First framework to repurpose a pretrained 3D generative model (TRELLIS-based) for autoregressive layout generation with identity-aware embeddings and dual-guidance self-rollout distillation to eliminate exposure bias.

title: BiProLoRA: Bilevel Prompt LoRA for Real Scene Recovery
novelty: Framing prompt-LoRA co-training as bilevel hyperparameter optimization, where prompts act as hyperparameters steering LoRA's synthetic training, enabling their complementary mutual reinforcement for robust synthetic-to-real adaptation.

title: SO-Bench: A Structural Output Evaluation of Multimodal LLM
novelty: First comprehensive benchmark for visual structured output evaluation covering diverse JSON schemas and 4 visual domains with a three-stage human-verified pipeline and both SFT and RLVR training experiments.

title: AVION: Aerial Vision-Language Instruction from Offline Teacher to Prompt-Tuned Network
novelty: Tri-aspect knowledge distillation (visual, textual, logit) from a domain-specific teacher with LLM-enriched textual prototypes to a prompt-tuned lightweight student for efficient remote sensing VLM adaptation.

title: Progressive Cross-Modal Causal Intervention for Long-Term Action Recognition
novelty: Multi-stage causal intervention framework that explicitly models causal relationships in cross-modal fusion rather than relying on statistical correlations.

title: SenseSearch: Empowering Vision-Language Models with High-Resolution Agentic Search-Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
novelty: The first end-to-end agentic VLM that coordinates multiple tool types (search and cropping) through RL-based reasoning, introducing BN-GSPO to stabilize training on multi-tool trajectories.

title: Generalizable Video Quality Assessment via Weak-to-Strong Learning
authors: Linhan Cao, Wei Sun, Xiangyang Zhu, et al.
novelty: Empirical validation that weak-to-strong generalization applies to subjective VQA: students trained on weak teacher labels can surpass their teachers on OOD benchmarks. The iterative W2S strategy with gMAD-based hard-sample selection progressively expands generalization capacity.

title: GEM: Generating LiDAR World Model via Deformable Mamba
novelty: First LiDAR world model with explicit dynamic-static disentanglement and support for autonomous rollout and controllable generation without requiring ground truth ego status.

title: Wavelet-based Frame Selection by Detecting Semantic Boundary for Long Video Understanding
novelty: Reframes frame selection as a signal-processing problem using wavelet multi-resolution analysis to detect semantic boundaries, prioritizing narrative structure over isolated relevance scores.

title: LEMON: A Large Endoscopic MONocular Dataset and Foundation Model for Perception in Surgical Settings
novelty: First large-scale surgical video dataset aggregated from online sources with automated curation pipeline; proposes self-supervised augmented distillation for surgical foundation models.

title: Focus on Background: Exploring SAM's Potential in Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
novelty: First work to systematically leverage SAM's background prompting for few-shot medical segmentation; background-centric prototype construction combined with structure-aware graph refinement.

title: RAID: Retrieval-Augmented Anomaly Detection
novelty: Reconceptualizing UAD as a Retrieval-Augmented Generation paradigm where hierarchical retrieval (class→semantic→instance) reduces matching dimensionality and a guided MoE filter leverages retrieved semantic prototypes as dual guidance to suppress matching noise in the anomaly cost volume.

title: FastRef: Fast Prototype Refinement for Few-shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
novelty: The key insight is using optimal transport to balance characteristic transfer and anomaly suppression, enabling efficient prototype refinement at test time without retraining.

title: From Infusion to Assimilation Distillation for Medical Image Segmentation
novelty: The key innovation is recognizing that poor knowledge distillation generalization stems from insufficient knowledge internalization, and addressing this through a two-stage framework that infuses teacher knowledge while actively assimilating it into the student model through contrastive self-optimization and reverse feature constraints.

title: A Unified Perspective on Adversarial Membership Manipulation in Vision Models
novelty: The first unified perspective that simultaneously formulates and evaluates both membership false assertion (MFA) and membership falsification detection (MFD) attacks against vision model MIAs, revealing gradient-norm collapse as the mechanism exploited by MFD.

title: EnergyAction: Unimanual to Bimanual Composition with Energy-Based Models
novelty: First framework to compositionally transfer unimanual manipulation policies to bimanual tasks using EBM composition with energy-based coordination.

title: LEAD: Minimizing Learner–Expert Asymmetry in End-to-End Driving
novelty: Systematic analysis identifying three critical sources of expert-student misalignment; expert redesign (rather than model improvement) becomes the bottleneck for closed-loop driving performance, achieved 95 DS on Bench2Drive through asymmetry reduction.

title: NuWa: Deriving Lightweight Class-Specific Vision Transformers for Edge Devices
novelty: First method to derive class-specific Vision Transformers by identifying and removing class-detrimental weights through self-knowledge purification and closed-form optimization without post-pruning retraining.

title: Hist2Style: Histogram-Guided Stylization with Bilateral Grids
novelty: Bilateral-grid photorealistic stylization network distilled from a large editing model and conditioned on a directly editable marginal color histogram, with the bilateral-grid constraint preventing hallucinations by construction.

title: RevINN: An End-to-End Invertible Neural Network for Reversible Adversarial Examples
novelty: First end-to-end INN that unifies adversarial perturbation and reversible information hiding entirely in the wavelet frequency domain, eliminating the two-stage pipeline and its associated error accumulation.

title: Learning Mutual View Information Graph for Adaptive Adversarial Collaborative Perception
novelty: Unified mutual view information graph representation that captures vulnerabilities across diverse defensive configurations, enabling adaptive attacks generalizable across different defense mechanisms.

title: TopoSlide: Topologically-Informed Histopathology Whole Slide Image Representation Learning
novelty: First approach to explicitly incorporate global topological constraints from persistent homology into WSI representation learning, capturing both local and global spatial organization of tissue architecture.

title: Orthogonal Spatial-Aware Multi-View Anchor Graph Clustering for Incomplete Remote Sensing Image Data
novelty: Orthogonal projection-based approach for multi-view clustering with spatial awareness and incomplete data handling.

title: Cross-Scale Pansharpening via ScaleFormer and the PanScale Benchmark
novelty: Reframing pansharpening cross-scale generalization as sequence-length generalization and using RoPE with SAP bucketed training to achieve zero-shot performance at unseen resolution ratios.
